title: Veteran guest Q&A
materials: Paper and pencil for each boy to record answers

displayContent.headline: Ask a veteran
displayContent.body: Ask your own questions. Write the answers in your own words for your mentor.
points: Why did you join, or were you drafted?
How was it different from what you expected?

leaderScript: Before the meeting, have each boy write two questions that cover the badge’s three: why the veteran joined or was drafted, what he expected, and how reality was different.
Introduce the guest and let the boys take turns asking.
Each boy records the answers in his own words. Whether this counts for the interview requirement is the mentor’s call.
No guest? Use the time to plan which Veterans Day event the group will attend (Wednesday, November 11, 2026).
ifShortOnTime: This step is optional and is skipped when Short on time is on.
lowVolunteerNote: Needs only the guest and one leader.
